name: agy-supervised-development
description: Strong-model task contracting, low-cost evidence supervision, observable handoffs, and AGY implementation through Herdr.

interface.shortDescription: Astra decides; Luna supervises; AGY builds; routing proves itself.
interface.longDescription: Freeze a compact task Contract with a strong reasoning model, supervise AGY with a cheaper model using Git/test evidence, expose runtime routing evidence when available, and escalate only when the Contract must change.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development: freeze WHAT/BOUNDARY/DONE with the architect, hand off to Luna with runtime routing evidence when available, let AGY decide normal HOW through Herdr, supervise with Git/test evidence, and escalate only when the Contract must change.
